title: A green-solvent-processable polymer hole transport material for achieving 26.31% efficiency in inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,4153-4161
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00380F, Paper
Sen Yin, Xuanang Luo, Fushen Tang, Zhihui Xiong, Youran Lin, Wenyu Yang, Yuanyuan Shu, Yang Wang, Lei Ying
A novel polymer hole transport material PTACz-PO consisting of a diethyl-phosphonate-modified carbazole moiety is developed that can be processed with a non-chlorinated solvent of 2-methyltetrahydrofuran.
